plugins.name: Live Routes
plugins.description: Real-time request routing dashboard for CLIProxyAPI: watch requests flow from clients through API keys to upstream models, with in-flight state, retries, token usage and session/sub-agent links. Memory only, nothing written to disk. | CLIProxyAPI 实时请求路由看板：实时查看请求从客户端、API Key 到上游模型的流向，含进行中状态、重试、Token 用量与会话/子代理关系。仅占用内存，不写入磁盘。
plugins.author: Roomen

plugins.name: Harness Usage
plugins.description: Local coding-harness usage dashboard for CLIProxyAPI: daily tokens, cache usage and estimated cost for Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode, collected from local history with ccusage. Per-source status, responsive UI, management-key protected. | CLIProxyAPI 本地 harness 用量看板：按日展示 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 的 token、缓存用量与估算费用，基于 ccusage 读取本地历史，按来源独立报错，界面自适应，数据经管理密钥鉴权。
plugins.author: Roomen
